citations.assessment: The target explicitly presents the competing father-name forms. Sanhedrin names Abba bar Acha Karsalla of Kafri; Rashi in Pesachim gives Rabbi Acha of Kafri and confirms that Chiyya and Ivo were paternal brothers.
